### Collection data

<script src="js/publication.js" defer></script>

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(DT)
library(dplyr)

source("helpers.R")

dat <- read.csv("intermediates/final_dat.csv", check.names = FALSE)

datatable(dat[, c("ID", "Tick species", "Source", "Collection year start", "Collection year end", "Collection site", "City", "LID", "DOI")], 
          escape = FALSE, 
          style = "bootstrap5",
          class = "wrap",
          filter = "top",
          extensions = c("Select", "SearchPanes", "Buttons"), 
          selection = "none",
          rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 25,
            dom = "PBfrtip",
            buttons = c("copy", "csv"),
            searchPanes = list(initCollapsed = TRUE, viewCount = FALSE),
            columnDefs = list(
              list(targets = c(7L:8), visible = FALSE),
              list(targets = c(0, 3L:8), searchPanes = list(show = FALSE)),
              list(targets = 0, render = render_collection),
              list(targets = c(1L:2), 
                   searchPanes = list(show = TRUE, orthogonal = "sp"),
                   render = JS("function(data, type, row, meta) {
                                  if (type === 'sp') {
                                    return data ? data.split(',').map(function(item) { return item.trim(); }) : data;
                                  }
                                return data;
                               }"))
            ),
            initComplete = JS("
              function(settings, json) {
                let targetDoi = decodeURIComponent(window.location.search.substring(1));
                
                console.log(targetDoi);
                
                if (targetDoi) {
                  var api = this.api();
                  api.column(-1).search('^' + $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex(targetDoi) + '$', true, false).draw();
                } 
              }
            ")
          )
)
```
